full_page.content:
1934, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 279 Page 280
Blank Page
Dec. 14 Ignacy Suchocki - 49 - was given up - had Heart-trouble, like can- cer of stomach and liver - given up as hopeless. His wife made novena to Our Lady of perpetual Help and begs for St. Anthony's bread .... Husband now quite well-looking for work. Prayers. Thanks . . . .
16 Emma Doran - 48 - fearful asthma
Mrs. Roy-68 - fears operation on goitre - lost two daughters, en- rolled some time ago and now quite improved - prays to escape operation.
Mrs. Reid - Husband & four asks prayers thanking God for change in atitude of husband to religion after 20 yrs. Asks prayers for his parents now over 80 and just next to atheists.
Clara Mueller - 62 - cancer rectum.
Page 281 Page 282
Blank Page
Dec. 20 Mrs. Jaskolski - mother of little Raymond - thanks for prayers - boy seems improving - pray on.
Mrs. McItee - 48 - terrible asthma
Mrs. Eva Reid - 43 - cancer operation abandoned ... Husband & 4 lit- tle children home.
Mrs. Bradley -
Bernard Susewitz - 15 - epileptic - had been taking fits two week Enrolled last March and fits stoped - now recently starting again - father not Catholic.
Hazel Wellwood
Blank Page
Page 283 Page 284 Dec. 27 Rose Langdon - 46 - kidney-stones & heart .. operation expected in Ann Arbor - asks for brother - prayers for conversion.
